Women on Wheels Monthly Ride (PAA Cycling Club)

Pasadena, CA · Road

Women on Wheels Monthly Ride (PAA Cycling Club) is a road group ride in Pasadena, CA. Schedule: Last Sunday of each month, at a place the group announces ahead (Sept 27 was Elysian Park; Oct 25 is on the calendar). Intermediate and Advanced groups, from Set each month on the club calendar (Sept 27: Elysian Park, Heavy Water and Baker's Bench).

For visitors

A helmet is required. Bring a flat pack (spare tube, levers, patch kit, CO2, multi-tool), water, snacks and ID. Each group has a leader and a sweep. The page does not say whether guests need a PAA membership; ask through the WoW contact on the club site.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12-13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women on Wheels Monthly Ride (PAA Cycling Club) group ride

Women on Wheels is the PAA's women's group, with monthly no-drop road rides in the San Gabriel Valley and around Los Angeles. The group meets on the last Sunday of the month at a place posted ahead, then splits into an Intermediate and an Advanced group. Each group has a leader and a sweep. Open to women of all ages and skill levels.
